limitations: These development trials are not a fixed-version statistical benchmark.
No stochastic model replay was performed after the final domain separation.
Successful declared equations do not prove a complete business audit or a correct business interpretation.
Unknown derived semantics and ambiguous domains require explicit source bindings and policy.
The registry is a lightweight semantic layer, not a full OWL/RDF ontology reasoner.
